description: Provenance registry for every source referenced by the AiT demo input pack. Every input artifact cites one or more source ids from this file.

sources.title: WiT Singapore 2026 — full programme (official event site)
sources.contentScope: Three-day programme structure: day layout, session blocks, session timing patterns, session formats, role mix (speaker/interviewer/moderator/panel/coach/judge/dragon/facilitator/curator/referee), speaker names and job titles as published, venue and room names. Session descriptive prose was NOT copied into this pack; only structural facts and short factual titles/times were normalized.
sources.licenseNote: Copyright remains with WiT (Web in Travel) / Northstar Travel Group. Used here only as a structural template reference; the synthetic AiT programme derives structure, not prose.

sources.title: WiT Singapore — event overview page (dates, venue framing)
sources.contentScope: Corroborates 2026 edition dates and three-day framing.

sources.title: Web in Travel homepage — WiT Singapore 30 Sep - 2 Oct 2026
sources.contentScope: Independent corroboration of the 30 Sep - 2 Oct 2026 date window.

sources.contentScope: Empirical Atlas sandbox evidence that SIN inbound searches return real offers from KUL/BKK/MNL/HKG/CGK/SYD/TYO (carriers TR/VJ/AK/FD/OD/D7), and that KUL->SIN completed the full order/pay/ticket chain. Governs the choice of travel-managed origin cities.
